goal.en: Tell a story in English: irregular past verbs, past continuous, and when/while.
goal.ar: أن تسرد قصة بالإنجليزية: الأفعال الشاذة، والماضي المستمر، واستخدام when وwhile.

text.en: About 150 common English verbs do not take -ed. They must be learned as pairs, and they are the verbs you use most.
text.ar: نحو ١٥٠ فعلاً شائعاً لا تأخذ ed، وتُحفظ كأزواج. والمفارقة أنها أكثر الأفعال استعمالاً.

text.en: After did / didn't the verb returns to its base form: “Did you go?” “I didn't go.” — never “didn't went”.
text.ar: بعد did وdidn't يعود الفعل مجرداً: Did you go? / I didn't go، ولا نقول didn't went.

text.en: was/were + -ing describes an action already in progress at a past moment: At 8 p.m. I was studying.
text.ar: was/were مع ing تصف حدثاً كان جارياً في لحظة ماضية: At 8 p.m. I was studying.

items.en: They were waiting for the bus.
What were you doing at midnight?
items.ar: ماذا كنت تفعل عند منتصف الليل؟

text.en: The long background action takes the past continuous; the short interrupting action takes the past simple: I was cooking when the phone rang.
text.ar: الحدث الطويل الخلفي يأخذ الماضي المستمر، والحدث القصير المفاجئ يأخذ الماضي البسيط: I was cooking when the phone rang.

text.en: “While” usually introduces the long action; “when” usually introduces the short one.
text.ar: غالباً تأتي while مع الحدث الطويل، وwhen مع الحدث القصير.

items.en: While I was walking home, I met an old friend.
items.ar: بينما كنت أمشي إلى البيت قابلت صديقاً قديماً.

items.en: The lights went out while we were having dinner.

questions.sentence: We ___ to the cinema last night.

explanation.en: After didn't the verb is in the base form: didn't take.
explanation.ar: بعد didn't يأتي الفعل مجرداً: didn't take.

prompt.en: Match the verb with its past form.

explanation.en: Irregular verbs change their vowel or their whole shape.
explanation.ar: الأفعال الشاذة تغيّر حركتها أو شكلها بالكامل.

questions.sentence: I ___ my keys, so I ___ get into the flat.

explanation.en: lose → lost, and the past of can is could (negative: couldn't).
explanation.ar: ماضي lose هو lost، وماضي can هو could ونفيها couldn't.

questions.sentence: At nine o'clock last night I ___ for my exam.

explanation.en: An action in progress at a specific past time → past continuous.
explanation.ar: حدث كان جارياً في وقت ماضٍ محدد، فنستخدم الماضي المستمر.
مع they نستخدم were مع الفعل بـ ing.

questions.answer: What were you doing at six

explanation.ar: أداة السؤال ثم were ثم الفاعل ثم الفعل بـ ing.

explanation.en: The long background action is continuous; the short interrupting one is simple.
explanation.ar: الحدث الطويل مستمر، والحدث القصير المقاطع بسيط.

questions.sentence: ___ we were driving to Aswan, the car broke down.

explanation.en: “While” introduces the longer action in progress. (“During” is followed by a noun, not a clause.)
explanation.ar: while تُدخل الحدث الطويل الجاري. أما during فيليها اسم لا جملة.

prompt.en: “When I arrived, they were leaving.” What happened first?
prompt.ar: «When I arrived, they were leaving» أيهما بدأ أولاً؟

options: I arrived, then they started to leave.

explanation.en: The continuous shows the action was already in progress when I arrived.
explanation.ar: المستمر يدل على أن مغادرتهم كانت قد بدأت بالفعل لحظة وصولي.

options: While I was reading, I fell asleep.
When she called, I was working.
While I read a book, the door was ringing suddenly.
They were talking when the teacher came in.

explanation.en: A sudden, short event (the door ringing) takes the past simple: “the door rang suddenly”.
explanation.ar: الحدث المفاجئ القصير يأخذ الماضي البسيط: the door rang suddenly.

prompt.en: Put into the past: “I see him at the station.”
prompt.ar: حوّلها إلى الماضي: I see him at the station.

questions.answer: i saw him at the station

questions.sentence: I ___ my old teacher while I ___ in the market.

explanation.en: Meeting is the short event (simple); shopping is the background (continuous).
explanation.ar: اللقاء حدث قصير فيأخذ البسيط، والتسوق خلفية مستمرة فيأخذ المستمر.

questions.sentence: — Did you ___ the message? — Yes, I ___ it this morning.

explanation.en: After “did”, use the base form (get); in the answer, use the past form (got).
explanation.ar: بعد did يأتي الفعل مجرداً get، وفي الإجابة نستخدم صيغة الماضي got.

prompt.en: Which sentence describes a repeated past habit rather than one moment?
prompt.ar: أي جملة تصف عادة ماضية متكررة لا لحظة واحدة؟

options: I was walking to school at 7:30.
I walked to school every day that year.
I was walking when I saw him.
I was walking home yesterday evening.

explanation.en: The past simple with “every day” expresses a repeated habit; the continuous fixes one moment.
explanation.ar: الماضي البسيط مع every day يدل على عادة متكررة، أما المستمر فيحدد لحظة بعينها.
